questions.explanation: B is correct: ACCOMMODATION. Memory aid: double-c (two c's) + double-m (two m's) + -ation. The word 'accommodate' has double letters: acCOMModate. Trap: 'Accomodation' (single m) and 'Acomodation' (single c) are the most common errors.

B is correct: RECEIVE. Rule: 'i before e, except after c.' After the letter 'c', use 'ei' not 'ie'. Re-C-EIVE: the c comes before ei. Other words following this rule: deceive, perceive, conceive, ceiling. Trap: 'Recieve' is the most common misspelling — reversing 'ei' to 'ie' after 'c'.

A is correct: MISCHIEVOUS. It has 3 syllables: mis-chie-vous (NOT mis-chie-vi-ous). The word contains 'mischief' + '-ous' (not mischief + '-ious'). Trap: 'Mischievious' (4 syllables) is incorrect — the extra 'i' is often inserted due to mispronunciation; 'Mischeivous' misspells the 'ief' → 'eiv' sequence.

B is correct: OCCURRENCE. Double-c + double-r + -ence: oc-CUR-RENCE. Memory aid: the word occurs from 'occur' (which doubles the 'r' when adding a suffix starting with a vowel in British English). Trap: 'Occurence' (single r), 'Occurrance' (wrong suffix -rance), and 'Ocurrence' (single c) are common errors.

B is correct: ASSASSINATION. Memory trick: ASS + ASS + IN + ATION (two 'ass' + nation). The word contains two consecutive 'ss' pairs: ASSASSIN + -ATION. Trap: 'Assasination' has only one 'ss' in the middle; 'Asassination' has only one 's' at the start.

A is correct: CONSCIENTIOUS (con-sci-en-tious). It contains 'SCIENCE' inside: con-SCIEN-tious. Memory aid: a conscientious person has 'science' in their work ethic. Trap: 'Concientious' drops the 's'; 'Consciencious' inserts an extra 'c' from confusing it with 'conscience'; 'Consientious' drops the 'c' after 'con'.

B is correct: MILLENNIUM. Root: Latin mille (thousand) + annum (year) = thousand years. The double 'l' comes from 'mille' and the double 'n' from 'annum'. Memory aid: MILL + ENN + IUM. Trap: 'Millenium' (double l, single n) is the most common error — students double the 'l' correctly but forget the double 'n'.

B is correct: PHARAOH. The unusual spelling comes from Ancient Egyptian through Greek. Note the vowel sequence: a-a-o-h (PH-A-R-A-O-H). Memory aid: Pharaoh has no 'r' before the second 'a' — PHAR + AOH. Trap: 'Pharoah' (most common error) puts 'o' before 'a'; the correct order is 'a' + 'o' + 'h'.

A is correct: BUREAUCRACY. From French 'bureau' (office/desk) + Greek '-cracy' (rule/government) = rule by offices. Spelling breakdown: BUR + EAU + CRA + CY. Note 'eau' not 'eau' reversed. Trap: 'Beaurocracy' inserts an extra 'e' after 'beau' (likely confusing with the French word 'beau'); 'Burocracy' drops the 'eau' entirely.

C is correct: MAINTENANCE. Note: the root is 'maintain' but the noun shifts to 'maint-EN-ance' (not maintainance). Breakdown: MAIN + TEN + ANCE. The vowel changes: maintain → maintenance (the 'ai' in maintain becomes 'e' in maintenance). Trap: 'Maintainance' keeps the 'ai' from 'maintain' (wrong — the vowel shifts in the noun form); 'Maintenence' uses '-ence' instead of '-ance'.
